cases.name: Vineet Narain v. Union of India
cases.facts: The Court addressed executive inertia in investigation of allegations involving high public officials and developed institutional directions to secure accountability.
cases.issue: How can constitutional institutions enforce accountability where executive investigation is ineffective?
cases.ratioDecidendi: Judicial review may be used to secure lawful investigation and institutional accountability while respecting the constitutional allocation of functions.
cases.holding: The Court issued continuing directions and emphasised probity and rule of law.
cases.relevance: Use for the accountability rationale underlying independent anti-corruption institutions.

cases.name: Centre for Public Interest Litigation v. Union of India
cases.facts: The Court examined appointment and institutional integrity issues concerning the Central Vigilance Commission framework.
cases.issue: What institutional principles govern anti-corruption oversight bodies?
cases.ratioDecidendi: Institutional integrity and transparent, legally structured appointment processes are essential to public accountability bodies exercising significant statutory functions.
cases.holding: The Court scrutinised the institutional arrangement on constitutional and statutory grounds.
cases.relevance: Use for institutional integrity and anti-corruption oversight.

cases.name: Lok Prahari v. Union of India
cases.facts: The Court considered statutory and constitutional questions concerning public accountability and high public office.
cases.issue: What is the constitutional basis for accountability of public functionaries?
cases.ratioDecidendi: Public office is subject to constitutional accountability, transparency and lawful institutional controls; judicial review may protect those requirements without replacing the statutory authority.
cases.holding: The Court applied constitutional accountability principles.
cases.relevance: Use as supplementary authority for public-functionary accountability, alongside the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013.
